expected_behavior: No production code lands without a failing test first: RED, GREEN, REFACTOR run per task, and code written before its test is deleted and rewritten from the test.
Every commit goes through the x-commit skill's commit.mjs; a raw `git commit` is never run, and a commit.mjs validation error stops the task rather than being bypassed.
Task status stamps — started, ready, done, finished — are written only by status.mjs; nobody sets them by hand.
After an x-parallel batch merges, the full test suite and the VERIFY step run on the merged changes before any status update is made.
A floor-guard exit of 2 (could not run) is reported as not-a-pass, and a red suite blocks the commit instead of being committed beside.
